summary: The prepared source already contains upstream PR #33365's issue-specific local-path routing fix. The reported revision fails to recognize /workspace/vlm_dataset/MiniMax-H3 and can select DiffusersTI2VPipelineConfig, while the prepared source resolves the same basename to MiniMaxH3PipelineConfig, which defines audio_vae_config. No additional source change is justified.

tests.what_was_measured: The repository's focused MiniMax-H3 routing regression passed (1 test).

The reported-revision substring matcher returned None for /workspace/vlm_dataset/MiniMax-H3; the prepared matcher returned MiniMaxH3Pipeline. Exact near-name boundaries MiniMax-H3.5 and MiniMax-H3-4B returned None, and the Hugging Face cache-layout path returned MiniMaxH3Pipeline.
Actual prepared registry resolution selected MiniMaxH3Pipeline and MiniMaxH3PipelineConfig for a real local directory with the reported basename.
The assigned device is one AMD Instinct MI355X with gfx950 ISA, which differs from the reported eight NVIDIA H800 system.

gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU workload was run: the demonstrated defect and fix are CPU-side path-to-pipeline/config routing. Inventory confirmed one gfx950 GPU, but MiniMax-H3 weights and the reported 8xH800 CUDA topology were unavailable.

remaining_limitations: MiniMax-H3 weights were unavailable, so full component loading and generation were not executed.
The assigned host has one AMD gfx950 GPU rather than eight NVIDIA H800 GPUs; CUDA, tensor-parallel, Ulysses, and multi-node or multi-GPU behavior remain unverified.
Transport and generic tiny-Llama fixtures cannot qualify the MiniMax-H3 architecture and were therefore not used as substitute evidence.
This result verifies the exact routing/config mismatch visible in the issue traceback, not output semantics or model quality.
